<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier implemented using pipelined design.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal for multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal for multiplication result.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOAD">State LOAD.</parameter>
        <parameter id="CALCULATE">State CALCULATE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">State OUTPUT.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" width_description="[1:0]">Register to hold the output enable signal.</reg>
        <wire id="temp[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the first partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the second partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the third partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the fourth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the fifth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[5]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the sixth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[6]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the seventh partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[7]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to hold the eighth partial product.</wire>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the multiplicand.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the multiplier.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the first partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the second partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the third partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the fourth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the fifth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[5]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the sixth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[6]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the seventh partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[7]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the eighth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the final product.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // Reset the output enable register to zero
                mul_en_out_reg <= 2'b0;
            end else begin
                // Update the output enable register with the input enable signal
                mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[0], mul_en_in};
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block to generate partial products based on the multiplier bits
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : pp_gen
                assign temp[i][15:0] = ({8{mul_b_reg[i]}} & mul_a_reg);
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Sequential logic blocks to update the partial sums based on the current stage of calculation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // Reset all partial sum registers to zero
                sum[0] <= 16'd0;
                sum[1] <= 16'd0;
                sum[2] <= 16'd0;
                sum[3] <= 16'd0;
                sum[4] <= 16'd0;
                sum[5] <= 16'd0;
                sum[6] <= 16'd0;
                sum[7] <= 16'd0;
            end else begin
                case (mul_en_out_reg)
                    2'b01: begin
                        // Calculate partial sums based on the current stage of calculation
                        sum[0] <= temp[0];
                        sum[1] <= temp[1] + temp[2];
                        sum[2] <= temp[3] + temp[4];
                        sum[3] <= temp[5] + temp[6];
                        sum[4] <= temp[7];
                        sum[5] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[6] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[7] <= 16'd0;
                    end
                    
                    2'b10: begin
                        // Calculate partial sums based on the current stage of calculation
                        sum[0] <= temp[0];
                        sum[1] <= temp[1] + temp[2];
                        sum[2] <= temp[3] + temp[4];
                        sum[3] <= temp[5] + temp[6];
                        sum[4] <= temp[7];
                        sum[5] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[6] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[7] <= 16'd0;
                    end
                    
                    default: begin
                        // Default case to handle other cases
                        sum[0] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[1] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[2] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[3] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[4] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[5] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[6] <= 16'd0;
                        sum[7] <= 16'd0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block to update the final product based on the calculated partial sums
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                // Reset the final product register to zero
                mul_out_reg <= 16'd0;
            end else begin
                // Accumulate the partial sums to get the final product
                mul_out_reg <= sum[0] + sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3] + sum[4] + sum[5] + sum[6] + sum[7];
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the output product based on the output enable signal
        assign mul_out = (mul_en_out_reg[1]) ? mul_out_reg : 16'd0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements a 8-bit unsigned multiplier using pipelined design.</implementation>
</module>
